description: Get full DFT-computed properties for a material by Materials Project ID (e.g. mp-149 for silicon). Returns: band gap, formation energy, thermodynamic stability, density, crystal structure, spacegroup, magnetism, bulk/shear modulus, Poisson ratio, Fermi energy, database cross-references. 150K+ materials (Materials Project)

material_id.description: Materials Project ID (e.g. "mp-149" for silicon, "mp-19017" for LiFePO4). Get IDs from materials.search

name: science.materials.details

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Material Properties
